paragraphs: 6 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Sunday for 6 clubs across 2 levels, with Bryan Woo producing the night's most notable performance.
Bryan Woo started on the mound for Seattle Mariners.
Bryan Woo worked 8.0 innings, allowing 1 hit and 0 earned runs, with 2 walks and 9 strikeouts.
One of his strikeouts came in the fifth on a 0-2 97 mph four-seam fastball, when he put away Alika Williams.

Ryan Tayman went 1-for-3, 1 home run, 1 RBI, 1 run scored, 2 walks for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. Ryan Tayman's home run — his 5th of the season came in the first inning on a 3-2 90 mph changeup from Kifraidy Encarnacion. The swing moved the score from 1-1 to 2-1. Statcast measured the ball at 102.8 mph off the bat, a 30-degree launch angle. He batted fourth and started behind the plate. St. Lucie Mets beat Jupiter Hammerheads, 11-10.

Alejandro Garza went 3-for-5, 1 double, 3 runs scored, 1 walk, 3 stolen bases for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. Alejandro Garza produced a double in the first to right field on a 0-1 pitch from Berny Ortiz. He batted second and started at third base. Hill City Howlers beat Salem RidgeYaks, 10-7.

Brooks Lee went 2-for-3, 1 home run, 1 RBI, 1 run scored for Minnesota Twins. Brooks Lee's home run — his 23th of the season came in the seventh inning on a 1-1 98 mph four-seam fastball from Grant Taylor. The swing moved the score from 0-4 to 1-4. Statcast measured the ball at 104.5 mph off the bat, a 28-degree launch angle, 425 feet. He batted second and started at third base. Minnesota Twins fell to Chicago White Sox, 1-10.

Tanner Sagouspe came on in relief for Fresno Grizzlies in the top of the seventh with nobody out. He worked 2.0 innings, allowing 0 hits and 0 earned runs, with 1 walk and 3 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the seventh on a 2-2 pitch, when he put away Lorenzo Meola. Fresno Grizzlies fell to San Jose Giants, 3-5.

Andrew Alvarez started on the mound for Washington Nationals. He worked 4 1/3 innings, allowing 4 hits and 3 earned runs, with 2 walks and 5 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the second on a 0-2 87 mph changeup, when he put away Miguel Rojas. Washington Nationals fell to Los Angeles Dodgers, 5-7.
title: Bryan Woo turns in a strong outing on the mound
